known_limitations: The Liquid 27 buttons reproduce the documented behaviour of interactive Liquid Glass; Apple does not publish its values, so they are not pixel-identical.
The four collection pages share buttons and a cover glow but keep their own layouts; a deeper redesign is proposed, not done.
A 3 % change of speed is at the edge of what can be perceived.
The cover glow is replaced by a plain gradient in performance mode or when a collection has no cover.
The signing certificate is the existing public Android debug identity, not a private production key.
